why: The question detector anchors on a line ENDING in '?'. A question wrapped in parentheses ends in '?)' and never matched — #524's "(Why don't we say his name?)" sat in Context instead. 50 lines corpus-wide have that shape; only the ones the owner rules are added.

rulings.reasoning: Owner ruling: it is a question, so it is classified as a question. The detector missed it because the line ends in '?)' rather than '?' — the closing parenthesis defeats the question-form test.
rulings.renderNote: Highlighted blue as a Question like any other.
